Cone.label: ON-bipolar cell

BC.label: retinal bipolar neuron
BC.def_summary: A bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with photoreceptors cells and neurons in the inner plexiform layer.

AC.label: amacrine cell
AC.def_summary: Interneuron of the vertebrate retina. They integrate, modulate, and interpose a temporal domain in the visual message presented to the retinal ganglion cells, with which they synap

HC.label: retina horizontal cell
HC.def_summary: A neuron that laterally connects other neurons in the inner nuclear layer of the retina.

RGC.label: retinal ganglion cell
RGC.def_summary: The set of neurons that receives neural inputs via bipolar, horizontal and amacrine cells. The axons of these cells make up the optic nerve.

MG.label: Mueller cell
MG.def_summary: Astrocyte-like radial glial cell that extends vertically throughout the retina, with the nucleus are usually in the middle of the inner nuclear layer.

Micro.label: microglial cell
Micro.def_summary: A central nervous system macrophage found in the parenchyma of the central nervous system. Marker include CD11b-positive, F4/80-positive, and CD68-positive.

RPE.label: retinal pigment epithelial cell
RPE.def_summary: An epithelial cell of the retinal pigmented epithelium.
